hierarchy.h1_display: text-5xl tracking-tighter uppercase (approx 48px, use Bebas Neue)
hierarchy.h2_section: text-3xl tracking-tight uppercase (approx 30px, use Bebas Neue)
hierarchy.h3_card: text-xl tracking-tight uppercase (approx 20px, use Bebas Neue)

component_rules.cards: Flat background (#171717), 1px solid border (#262626), rounded-lg (8px). NO drop shadows. Tactical minimalism. Use generous internal padding.
component_rules.buttons: Solid primary color (#FF3B30 or #007AFF depending on context), rounded-md (6px), centered bold text (Manrope or Bebas Neue). High contrast active states.
component_rules.inputs: Background #0A0A0A, border #262626, text #FFFFFF. Active state border turns primary color. rounded-md.
component_rules.navigation_tabs: Bottom tab navigator with #0A0A0A background, top border #262626. Inactive icons #A3A3A3, active icons #FFFFFF or primary context color.
component_rules.charts: Use react-native-chart-kit. Transparent background. Use primary_workout (#FF3B30) for workout metrics and primary_nutrition (#007AFF) for nutrition metrics. Text #A3A3A3.
component_rules.badges: Small pills (rounded-full), uppercase overline text, bordered or subtly tinted background (e.g., bg-primary_workout/10 border-primary_workout).

image_urls.description: Red and black dumbbell on black floor, dark gym atmosphere for welcome/onboarding screen.
Colorful healthy meal prep in containers. Use as a placeholder for the meal scanning AI feature.
Woman reaching into an open fridge. Use as placeholder/background for fridge scan AI feature.

accessibility_and_motion.contrast: Text contrast strictly follows APCA. Primary text is #FFFFFF on #0A0A0A (high contrast).
accessibility_and_motion.motion: Use React Native Reanimated or LayoutAnimation for smooth list insertions and active state transitions.
accessibility_and_motion.test_attributes: CRITICAL: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `testID` attribute (React Native equivalent of data-testid). Format: kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is an Expo React Native app. Apply the styling guidelines using standard StyleSheet or NativeWind. The class names provided in spacing_and_layout are Tailwind standards; translate them if using pure StyleSheet.
Install and use `@expo-google-fonts/bebas-neue` and `@expo-google-fonts/manrope`. Bebas Neue is strictly for H1/H2/H3 and big numeric data points. Manrope is for body, labels, inputs, and buttons.
Use `lucide-react-native` for all icons. Avoid generic emojis.
Wrap all main screens in `SafeAreaView` from `react-native-safe-area-context` to ensure proper spacing on devices.
Maintain the DARK 'Performance Pro' archetype. Do not use white backgrounds for screens. Deliver a tactical, dense card-based UI with thin 1px borders.
Use the `testID` attribute for all interactive elements instead of `data-testid` (since this is React Native). Example: <TouchableOpacity testID='login-submit-button'>
For charts, install `react-native-chart-kit` and customize the theme to match the dark color palette rather than using its defaults.
Always rely on the `image_urls` provided in this JSON for media placeholders. Do not use generic dummyimage/placehold URLs.
